label: STOPP J5
title: Systemic oestrogen with a history of breast cancer
statement: Systemic oestrogens with a history of breast cancer (increased risk of recurrence).

source.document: O'Mahony D, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632, Appendix 1 (corrected supplementary file; NHS Somerset copy used for text, sentence-identical to the earlier parse)
source.citation: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y
source.credit: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y

plain_summary: Oestrogen taken by mouth, patch or gel can raise the chance of breast cancer coming back in a woman who has had it.

medicine_groups.name: Systemic oestrogens
medicine_groups.note: Vaginal tablets, creams, pessaries and rings do not count, for example Vagifem and Ovestin. Estradiol valerate (Progynova) counts as estradiol. Combination products with a progestogen are named. Tibolone is not in this group. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too. Estrogel Pro contains systemic estradiol gel and progesterone capsules. Oral tablets and capsules, patches and skin gels count.

needs_facts.meets: A condition line that says the person has had breast cancer

rule_for_models: Apply this criterion from age 65 and ask for age before confirming a finding if age is unknown. When a Group A systemic oestrogen is supplied and a condition line records a history of breast cancer, suspect a finding and cite the supply and condition lines. With a Group A supply, report a possible finding if breast cancer history is missing and name the missing history, or report no finding if the record explicitly rules out that history.
cannot_be_seen: Breast cancer history, type and dates may be missing. The supply may name the prescriber, but the reason for oestrogen therapy and any specialist advice may be missing.
ask_the_gp: A review of whether the oestrogen is still suitable, taking into account any history of breast cancer.
